response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT s.telescref, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), base AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS baseline FROM linked), grp AS (SELECT telescref, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase FROM linked GROUP BY telescref, weathprofile) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_mod) AS avg_modindex, AVG(g.avg_phase) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(g.avg_mod - b.baseline) AS avg_excess_over_baseline FROM grp g CROSS JOIN base b WHERE g.avg_mod > b.baseline GROUP BY g.weathprofile

assumptions.assumption: Inner joins signals -> telescopes -> observatories drop unmatched signals. The baseline is the plain average of modindex over the linked signals (each signal counts equally). Signals with a NULL modindex are ignored by AVG, as are NULL phase shifts.
A NULL weathprofile is kept as its own group and output row.
